attempts.reopen_condition: A retained/audited exact indexed-terminal -> integral Picard64 completion system (or eliminated equivalent) becomes available through the EX5 external-consumption gate; then test local emptiness on one bounded exact terminal/stratum before any scale-out.
attempts.exact_population: The 688101306360803751427719294-member indexed terminal family over the frozen 178 residual unibranch rows, addressed by (row_id,d,e,terminal_rank); any cut must preserve this exact manifest.
hypotheses: complete integral Picard64 completion constraints are source-locked for the addressed terminal/stratum
all finite-ring reductions are necessary consequences of those exact constraints
the preimage from a rejected residue/stratum back to terminal ranks is exact and population-preserving
attempts.distinctness: Unlike S34-W02, this route has no Mordell-Weil parameter or quotient rational-point claim; unlike EX5R-MOD it acts directly on Picard64 completion feasibility rather than a new modular/uniformization object.

attempts.reopen_condition: After a retained/audited exact completion system is consumed, try exact LP dual infeasibility first; if the LP relaxation is feasible, use a proof-producing exact integer certificate only on a bounded representative stratum.
attempts.exact_population: A complete explicitly keyed subset of the same frozen FULL178 indexed terminal family; certificate scope must be encoded in the artifact and cannot be extrapolated across rows/strata.
hypotheses: all completion constraints and bounds used in the certificate are exact consequences of FULL178 semantics
certificate arithmetic is exact and independently replayable
integer-specific cuts, if used, are themselves proof-producing and valid for every terminal in the certified stratum
